messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: anomaly detected on /generate - error-rate spike (5xx) coincident with rollout of model v2026.03 to canary nodes. Canary % traffic: 10%. Metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/r/abc123
Jen (Oncall): Ack. Paging oncall. Can we get a quick scope: errors only on /generate? Any user-visible corruption?
Mike (Infra): Observed mismatch between deployed weight bundle and release manifest. weights_sha != manifest_sha on 3 canaries. Also tokenizer metadata shows tokenizer_version=2.1 but model artifact expects 2.3.
Mike (Infra): snippet:
```
expected: {
  "model_version": "v2026.03",
  "weights_sha": "def456",
  "tokenizer_version": "2.3"
}
deployed: {
  "weights_sha": "abc123",
  "tokenizer_version": "2.1"
}
```
Tom (ML Infra): Confirming — canary logs contain garbled tokens and increased OOV tokens. Example output from request id r_8b2c:
```
Input: "Summarize the following..."
Output: "Ġ� �Ġerror� tokenization failure at pos 13"
```
Sara (SRE): We should flip the feature flag and stop rollout traffic to that variant. Command I propose: `/feature-flag set enable_model_v2026_03 false --env=prod`
Sara (SRE): Also recommend routing /generate to fallback model v2025.12 until we rollback the artifact.
infra-bot: Executing feature-flag command on prod... done. `enable_model_v2026_03=false` (propagated to edge within 15s) :white_check_mark:
Jen (Oncall): Good. @Mike @Tom start rollback and verify weights bundle integrity. @Alejandra please triage customer-facing impact.
Mike (Infra): Starting rollback of canary hosts to previous artifact (v2025.12). Job queued: rollback-job-8421.
Tom (ML Infra): Rollback job logs (tail):
```
[00:01] pulling v2025.12 artifact
[00:02] validating weights sha -> ok
[00:03] reloading tokenizer v2.3 -> ok
[00:04] bringing node back into service
```
Alejandra (Support): I see 3 customer tickets flagged as "weird answers" since 10:13UTC (cust-4492, cust-9911, cust-3320). Escalating to AMs and sending temporary advisory.
Jen (Oncall): PagerDuty incident PD-3489 created and assigned to Jen. Triage channel here. Impact: limited to canary cohort (~10%); potential customer-visible for small subset. Rollback ETA ~7-12m.
Sara (SRE): Quick checklist: 1) kill-switch flag set (done) 2) rollback job started (rollback-job-8421) 3) reroute complete? @infra-bot status?
infra-bot: Route update: /generate traffic rerouted to v2025.12 under prod routing policy. All edge nodes reporting normal responses. :white_check_mark:
Mike (Infra): Confirm weights now match manifest on 5/5 canaries that completed rollback. One node still draining (node-az3-17).
Tom (ML Infra): Post-rollback validation: synthetic tests passing; tokenizer outputs normalized; OOV rate back to baseline. Continuing to monitor.
Alejandra (Support): Notifying affected accounts: message sent, offering context and that we're rolling back; they'll route any follow-ups to support.
Jen (Oncall): Mitigation complete — kill-switch and rollback succeeded, traffic restored to stable model. Monitoring window 30m. Please log any customer impact details in PD incident and assign follow-up to `release-team` for root cause.
Sara (SRE): Filing immediate incident note. Owner: Tom (ML Infra) for postmortem (include how packaging step allowed tokenizer mismatch).
Tom (ML Infra): I'll capture artifact signing and manifest verification gaps. Preliminary hypothesis: CI job that bakes artifacts skipped tokenizer bump due to a tagging race.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> rollback applied, PD-3489 updated, severity reduced.
Jen (Oncall): Thanks team. If anyone sees re-emergence ping here. Alejandra, keep me posted on customer replies. :pray:
